profile.name: Aisyah
profile.title: AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
profile.tagline: Turning ML research into systems that actually ship.
profile.summary: I work across the full stack of building AI products — from transformer-based NLP research and explainable AI to shipping production web systems. Currently an AI Specialist at PT Gosyen Solusi Indonesia (GSI), where I build AI/ML tooling, full-stack internal systems, and automation pipelines end to end. My background spans transformer NLP (BERT/ALBERT), explainable AI (SHAP/LIME), medical imaging, multilingual speech-to-text (Whisper), and computer vision (YOLOv8) — and I care most about the step most research stops before: turning a model into something people actually use.
profile.focus: Currently developing toward an AI Engineer trajectory: MCP server architecture, agentic AI, and RAG with pgvector/Supabase.

points: Build and maintain AI/ML tooling, full-stack internal systems, and automation pipelines for HR/GA asset management and SEO content generation.
Design and ship production systems end to end — from data model to deployment — rather than handing research off to someone else to productionize.
Work spans WordPress plugin development, internal dashboards, and AI API integration (OpenAI, Gemini).
Worked on AI agent development, applying transformer NLP and explainability techniques.

projects.name: HR Inventory (AssetFlow)
projects.description: Asset and inventory management system for GSI, built end to end with AI-assisted development. Separates asset master data, borrowing transaction logs, and consumable stock into distinct modules with clean referential structure.
highlights: Supabase Auth with role-based access control (super_admin, hr, direktur)
Per-user borrowing record filtering and responsive dialog layouts
Deployed via Nginx + Bun on a VPS

projects.name: Uno GSI Content Generator
projects.description: WordPress plugin for AI-driven content generation, iteratively built across versions 2.7–2.9.x with migrations between OpenAI and Gemini APIs.
highlights: Integrated OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1) and Gemini 2.5 Flash, including prompt caching
Internal linking system with zone-spreading logic
WP-Cron self-ping mechanism to recover stuck jobs
Anti-duplicate sentence enforcement for generated content

projects.name: Station Command Center
projects.description: Concept and prototype for a security/operations dashboard for a transit station — CCTV AI detection, patrol logging, attendance, and incident management in one system.
highlights: YOLOv8-based CCTV detection for flood and trash monitoring
e-Patrol, e-Presensi, and incident management modules
Full-stack architecture: Node.js/Express/Socket.IO backend, Next.js frontend, Python AI service, Docker

projects.name: License Plate Detection & OCR
projects.description: Computer vision pipeline combining YOLOv8 for plate detection with a CRNN model for OCR, with iterative work on dataset structure and model accuracy.
highlights: YOLOv8 detection stage tuned for plate localization
CRNN-based OCR stage for character recognition
Debugged dataset path issues and improved accuracy through iteration

projects.name: Cyberbullying Detection with Explainable AI
projects.description: Transformer-based NLP research project detecting cyberbullying, paired with explainability methods so predictions can be understood rather than trusted blindly.
highlights: Applied SHAP and LIME to explain model predictions
Part of a broader ML research background spanning medical imaging and multilingual speech-to-text
